principles.name: Radical clarity
principles.statement: Every screen answers one dominant question a user actually has.
principles.rationale: The control plane exists to answer "can I trust this change?" — decoration that does not serve that question is removed.

principles.name: One primary action
principles.statement: Each screen shows at most one primary (accent) action.
principles.rationale: Competing primary actions dilute the decision the screen exists to support.

principles.name: Hierarchy through type and space
principles.statement: Visual hierarchy comes from the type scale and spacing scale, not decoration.
principles.rationale: Gradients, glass, and glow are generic AI-slop tells; restrained neutrals keep evidence legible.

principles.name: Closed scales
principles.statement: Type, spacing, radius, and motion values come from the token scales; arbitrary values are findings.
principles.rationale: Arbitrary values are how systems fragment one commit at a time.

principles.name: Status is never color alone
principles.statement: Every status renders a text label and/or symbol alongside its tone.
principles.rationale: WCAG 1.4.1, and color-blind operators must read release verdicts correctly.

principles.name: Explicit states
principles.statement: Loading, empty, error, and blocked states are designed explicitly — never a blank void.
principles.rationale: An undesigned state is an undesigned decision left to chance in production.

principles.name: Progressive disclosure
principles.statement: Primary workflows show conclusions; raw detail (digests, full lists) sits one intentional step deeper.
principles.rationale: Operators need answers first, reconstruction second — but always both.

principles.name: Evidence-backed claims
principles.statement: Interface claims about builds, checks, or decisions trace to sealed evidence.
principles.rationale: The product exists to make unproven claims impossible to miss.

owners.name: Design Systems
owners.responsibility: Owns @nas/ui: tokens, atoms/molecules, registry accuracy, and token exceptions.

owners.name: Control Plane
owners.responsibility: Owns apps/no-ai-slop: templates, pages, navigation, and page-level composition.

tokens.description: THE single action accent (mint). Reserved for the one primary action.
Hover shade of the action accent.
Text/icon color on the accent fill (4.5:1 on accent).
UI text stack (system fonts; no webfont payload).
tokens.value: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

tokens.description: Monospace stack for digests, ids, and code.
tokens.value: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

tokens.description: Titles; the heaviest weight in the system.
Resting card elevation (deeper in dark theme).
Reduced control height for secondary chrome controls only.
Minimum card width in responsive auto-fit grids.
Minimum label column width in definition lists.
Disabled-control opacity (paired with cursor + aria state, never alone).

components.name: Button
components.purpose: Trigger exactly one action. The primary variant is the screen’s one accent.

variants.name: primary
variants.purpose: The single primary action of a screen (mint accent).

variants.name: secondary
variants.purpose: Supporting actions on a bordered surface.

variants.name: compact
variants.purpose: First-class boolean prop reducing height for secondary chrome controls (combines with ghost/secondary; never with primary).

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual emphasis; defaults to secondary so primary is always deliberate.

props.name: compact
props.description: Reduced height for secondary chrome controls. Never with primary.

props.name: children
props.description: The action label. Buttons always carry visible text.

states.behavior: Token focus ring, offset outside the control.
opacity.disabled + not-allowed cursor; disabled attribute set.

components.responsiveBehavior: Fixed height; width follows content. No breakpoint changes.
prohibitedUses: More than one primary variant rendered on a single screen
Combining the compact modifier with the primary variant
Using a button for pure navigation when a link communicates it better

components.name: Badge
components.purpose: Show a status as label + symbol + tone — the tone alone never carries meaning.

props.name: tone
props.description: Status color pair.

props.name: label
props.description: The visible text label.

props.name: symbol
props.description: Decorative glyph (aria-hidden); the label carries the meaning.

components.responsiveBehavior: Inline pill; wraps with its line, never truncates its label.
prohibitedUses: Communicating status with tone alone (label or symbol is mandatory)
Making a badge clickable — use a Button or link instead
Metric-wall decoration: a badge must answer a decision question

components.name: VerdictBadge
components.purpose: Map a TC-10 release verdict to the badge vocabulary (pass/warning/fail/blocked).

props.name: verdict
props.description: The signed gate verdict to display.

prohibitedUses: Displaying a verdict that is not a real kernel output

components.name: GradeBadge
components.purpose: Map an anti-slop dimension grade to the badge vocabulary.

props.name: grade
props.description: pass | pass_with_concern | fail | not_tested.

prohibitedUses: Collapsing multiple dimension grades into one badge

components.name: Card
components.purpose: Group one topic (title, optional subtitle/action) on a bordered surface.

props.name: title
props.description: Card heading (h2).

props.name: subtitle
props.description: One-line qualifier under the title.

props.name: action
props.description: Trailing badge or control aligned with the title.

props.name: children
props.description: Card body.

states.behavior: Static surface; no hover elevation games.

components.responsiveBehavior: Fills its grid track; grids collapse via auto-fit at size.card-min.
prohibitedUses: Nesting cards inside cards
Using a card as a click target (cards are containers, not buttons)

components.name: PageHeader
components.purpose: Open every screen with the same structure: eyebrow, single h1, measure-limited description, optional single action.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Uppercase context label above the title.

props.name: title
props.description: The one h1 per page.

props.name: description
props.description: What this screen answers, in one or two sentences.

props.name: action
props.description: Trailing slot: the screen’s single primary action, or its overall status badge — never more than one element.

components.responsiveBehavior: Title and action wrap on narrow viewports; description keeps measure.
prohibitedUses: More than one PageHeader per screen
Placing multiple actions in the action slot

components.name: KeyValue
components.purpose: Present attributable facts (build ids, digests, commits) as a definition list.

props.name: items
props.description: Label/value pairs; values may embed badges or mono spans.

components.responsiveBehavior: Grid keeps a min label column; long values wrap, never overflow.
prohibitedUses: Free-form prose in values — facts only

components.name: ReasonList
components.purpose: List reasons/findings with a leading status and an EXPLICIT empty state — never a blank void.

props.name: items
props.description: Reasons with optional leading badge and secondary mono detail.

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: REQUIRED text shown when there are zero items.

states.behavior: Divided rows with leading status element.
Renders emptyLabel as muted text — mandatory prop.

components.responsiveBehavior: Rows stack their secondary detail under the primary on any width.
prohibitedUses: Omitting emptyLabel semantics by passing a decorative placeholder

components.name: ThemeToggle
components.purpose: Switch light/dark explicitly; defaults to the OS preference until the user chooses.

states.behavior: Shows the theme it will switch TO, with an aria-label.

components.responsiveBehavior: Compact ghost button; identical at all widths.
prohibitedUses: Auto-switching the theme without an explicit user action

components.name: NavLinks
components.purpose: Primary navigation listing only screens that exist; marks the current page for AT via aria-current.

states.behavior: Current page gets surface-2 fill + aria-current="page".

components.responsiveBehavior: Column in the sidebar; wraps horizontally under the top bar < 1024px.
prohibitedUses: Nav items for screens that do not exist yet

components.name: AppShell
components.purpose: The one persistent structure: brand + theme control + navigation beside a measured main column.

props.name: children
props.description: The page content.

components.responsiveBehavior: Structure adapts: sidebar becomes a top bar below breakpoint.desktop instead of shrinking.
prohibitedUses: Rendering a page outside the shell

components.name: OverviewPage
components.purpose: Answer: is this build ready, and what proves it? Entry point to the decision.

states.behavior: Renders real kernel output for the sample lifecycle.

components.responsiveBehavior: Card grid auto-fits at size.card-min; single column on mobile.
prohibitedUses: Adding metrics that do not change a release decision

components.name: ReleasePage
components.purpose: Show the signed staging + production decisions with exact blocking reasons and every dimension grade.

states.behavior: Real TC-10 decisions; blocked production shown honestly.
ReasonList renders explicit empty labels for zero reasons.

components.responsiveBehavior: Cards stack; key-value values wrap digests on narrow screens.
prohibitedUses: Hiding a blocking reason behind an aggregate

components.name: EvidencePage
components.purpose: Show the sealed TC-17 chain in order, with digests, and its live verification.

states.behavior: Chain records in sequence with kind labels + digests.
Header badge flips to "Chain invalid" when verification fails.

components.responsiveBehavior: Digests truncate with ellipsis; summaries wrap.
prohibitedUses: Rendering evidence that failed signature verification as valid

components.name: SystemPage
components.purpose: Answer: is the product system itself coherent? Renders the live registry validation, tokens, components, patterns, architecture check, and exceptions.

states.behavior: Validation problems render as danger findings, never hidden.

components.responsiveBehavior: Disclosure sections stack; token tables scroll inside their region.
prohibitedUses: Turning the registry into a decorative component gallery

patterns.name: Status vocabulary
patterns.purpose: One shared mapping from verdicts/grades to label + symbol + tone.
patterns.conditionsOfUse: Any status shown anywhere uses this vocabulary; new statuses extend the mapping, never invent ad-hoc colors.

patterns.name: One primary action
patterns.purpose: Each screen exposes at most one accent action, usually in the PageHeader slot.
patterns.conditionsOfUse: Screens with no dominant action render no primary button at all.

patterns.name: Explicit empty state
patterns.purpose: Zero-item lists say so in words instead of rendering a void.
patterns.conditionsOfUse: Every list that can be empty must supply a meaningful emptyLabel.

patterns.name: Evidence reference
patterns.purpose: Material claims render alongside their digest / evidence identifier in mono.
patterns.conditionsOfUse: Applies to builds, checks, decisions, and any "verified" claim.

patterns.name: Card grid
patterns.purpose: Summary cards in a responsive auto-fit grid that collapses to one column.
patterns.conditionsOfUse: Use for peer summaries only; never for a wall of vanity metrics.

patterns.name: Progressive disclosure
patterns.purpose: Conclusions render first; full inventories (tokens, records) expand behind a native disclosure.
patterns.conditionsOfUse: Detail must remain reachable by keyboard (native <details>/<summary>) and never hide failures.

accessibilityRules.requirement: Every interactive element shows a visible focus indicator.
Interactive controls are at least size.control (40px) tall; compact (36px) only for secondary chrome.
accessibilityRules.verification: base.css min-height tokens on .nas-btn and .nas-nav__link; rendered-height measurement is manual review (not yet automated).

accessibilityRules.requirement: Text meets 4.5:1 and UI accents 3:1 in both themes.
Status is conveyed by label/symbol plus tone, never tone alone.
All animation and transitions collapse under prefers-reduced-motion.
The current page is marked with aria-current="page" in primary navigation.
Every screen renders exactly one h1.
accessibilityRules.verification: e2e/browser-check.mjs structure assertion on every route.

exceptions.rationale: CSS media queries cannot read custom properties, so the responsive switch hard-codes (breakpoint.desktop - 1)px. The value is mirror-tested against breakpoint.desktop in registry.test.ts.
exceptions.remediation: Replace with CSS custom media / env() once baseline browser support lands; until then the mirror test prevents drift.
